NAME
    tool - manage cloud resources

SYNOPSIS
    tool GROUP | COMMAND [--help]

DESCRIPTION
    Unified command-line interface.

GROUPS
    GROUP is one of the following:

     auth
        Manage oauth2 credentials for the cloud CLI.

     compute
        Create and manipulate Compute Engine resources.

COMMANDS
    COMMAND is one of the following:

     help
        Search help text.

     version
        Print version information.

AVAILABLE COMMANDS
     config          View and edit configuration
     storage         Upload and download objects
